chunks: So peace be on the messengers,
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Peace be upon the messengers' in Surah As-Saffat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often viewed as a comprehensive salutation that encompasses all Prophets, with a special emphasis on the Ahl al-Bayt as the ultimate bearers of the message. It serves as a divine seal of approval for the messengers' steadfastness, linking their earthly trials to eternal peace in the Hereafter. This affirmation underscores the continuity of prophethood and the validity of the final Messenger, Muhammad (PBUH), within the broader chain of divine guidance.
